about: Words the copy does not gloss (the colophons) or that its glosses place wrongly: ours, from Monier-Williams and Apte; and under force the long compounds whose pairing with the copy's glosses is right though its sounds score low (checked by eye).

परिपूर्णचन्द्र.hi: पूर्ण चन्द्रमा (अगली पंक्तिके बिम्बानुकारिसे मिलकर: पूर्ण चन्द्रमाके बिम्ब-जैसा)
परिपूर्णचन्द्र.en: the full moon (with bimbānukāri on the next line: like the disc of the full moon)

विलयमंशुमदिन्दुखण्ड.hi: नाशको; चमकते हुए चन्द्रखण्ड (अगली पंक्तिके योग्याननंसे मिलकर)
विलयमंशुमदिन्दुखण्ड.en: destruction; the shining crescent of the moon (with yogyānanaṃ on the next line)

योग्याननं.en: the face worthy of (the shining crescent moon), like it

महा.hi: महा (अगली पंक्तिके पूर्वाम्‌के साथ: जिनके नामके पहले ‘महा’ है)
महा.en: mahā (with pūrvām on the next line: her whose name is preceded by “mahā”)

पूर्वामत्र.hi: जिनके पहले (महा) है उन्हें, अर्थात् महासरस्वतीको; यहाँ
पूर्वामत्र.en: her preceded by (mahā), that is, Mahāsarasvatī; here

फणिफणोत्तंसोरु.hi: नागोंके फणोंके आभूषणरूप बड़े (रत्नोंकी माला…, अगले शब्दोंसे मिलकर)
फणिफणोत्तंसोरु.en: great (strings of gems…, with the next words) that adorn the serpents’ hoods

रत्नावली.en: a string of gems (with the next line)

भास्वद्देहलतां.hi: जिनकी लता-जैसी देह (उन रत्नोंसे) चमक रही है उन्हें
भास्वद्देहलतां.en: her whose slender body shines (with those gems)

नेत्रां.hi: (सूर्य, चन्द्रमा और अग्नि जिनके) नेत्र हैं उन्हें
नेत्रां.en: her whose eyes are (the sun, the moon and fire)

मन्वन्तरे.en: in the manvantara (the age of a Manu)

देवीमाहात्म्ये.en: in the Devī Māhātmya (the glory of the Devī)

p: कीलक (कील, जो मन्त्रोंको कीलित करती है)

देवीकवचं.en: the Devī Kavaca (the armour of the Devī)

हरिहरब्रह्मविरचितं.hi: हरि, हर और ब्रह्माका रचा हुआ
हरिहरब्रह्मविरचितं.en: composed by Hari, Hara and Brahmā

अपराधक्षमापणस्तोत्रं.en: the Aparādha-kṣamāpaṇa Stotra (the hymn asking pardon for faults)

मधुकैटभवधो.en: the slaying of Madhu and Kaiṭabha

शक्रादिस्तुतिर्नाम.en: named the praise by Śakra and the gods

शुम्भनिशुम्भसेनानीधूम्रलोचनवधो.en: the slaying of Dhūmralocana, general of Śumbha and Niśumbha

चण्डमुण्डवधो.en: the slaying of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa

सुरथवैश्ययोर्वरप्रदानं.en: the granting of boons to Suratha and the merchant

नारायणीस्तुतिर्नामैकादशोऽध्यायः.en: the eleventh adhyāya, named the praise of Nārāyaṇī

सिद्ध्यन्त्युच्चाटनादीनि.hi: सिद्ध होते हैं; उच्चाटन (किसीको उसके स्थानसे हटा देनेका प्रयोग) आदि
सिद्ध्यन्त्युच्चाटनादीनि.en: succeed; uccāṭana (making a person quit his place by a rite) and the like
p: उच्चाटन (किसीको उसके स्थानसे हटा देनेका प्रयोग) आदि

सम्पत्तिरुच्चकैः.en: prosperity; greatly, in a high degree

मनःशोकविनाशिनी.en: the mind (object); Śokavināśinī, destroyer of sorrow

यानुच्चार्याविशेषतः.hi: जो; जिसका उच्चारण नहीं किया जा सकता; विशेष रूपसे
यानुच्चार्याविशेषतः.en: which (she); not to be uttered; distinctly, specifically
p: जिसका उच्चारण नहीं किया जा सकता

जगत्पात्यत्ति.hi: जगत्का; पालन करता है; ग्रस लेता है

समुत्पाट्य.en: having drawn out, having torn out

विच्छिन्नजङ्घास्त्वपरे.en: with legs (shanks) cut off; and; others

निभृतात्मजभृत्यदारा.hi: विनीत और निष्ठावान् पुत्र, सेवक और पत्नीवाले
निभृतात्मजभृत्यदारा.en: whose sons, servants and wives are humble and faithful

नैर्ऋत्यै.en: to Nairṛtī (a name of the Devī)

चितिरूपेण.en: in the form of consciousness, the thinking mind

भक्तिविनम्रमूर्तिभिः.en: by those whose bodies are bowed in devotion

तलप्रहारेण.en: with a blow of the palm (the paw)

रथस्थस्तथात्युच्चैर्गृहीतपरमायुधैः.hi: रथपर स्थित; तथा; बहुत ऊँचे (उठाये हुए); श्रेष्ठ आयुध धारण की हुई (भुजाओंसे)
रथस्थस्तथात्युच्चैर्गृहीतपरमायुधैः.en: standing in the chariot; and; very high aloft; holding supreme weapons

प्रतीक्षिष्याम्यहं.en: I shall look upon (with favour), receive; I

तस्यां.en: when she (locative absolute) / when that woman (locative absolute) / in that, at that

निर्विण्णोऽतिममत्वेन.en: despondent, disgusted; through excessive sense of possession

प्रसभकृतिवशात्.en: through doing it forcibly, by force

सोममाहनसं.en: Soma (object); to be beaten or pressed out

वाम्या.en: I blow (vāmi; ā, the prefix of ārabhamāṇā)

रभमाणा.en: (ā)rabhamāṇā: laying hold of, setting in motion

पृथिव्यै.en: (beyond) the earth (pṛthivyā; the e is etāvatī's)

तावती.en: so vast (etāvatī; its e joined to pṛthivyai)

सं.hi: (बभूवका उपसर्ग) — सं बभूव: हो गयी हूँ
सं.en: (prefix of babhūva) — saṃ babhūva: I have become

विश्वो.en: all (viśvā, with the u of uta)

तामूं.hi: और (उत, जिसका उ विश्वोमें है); उस
तामूं.en: and (uta, its u joined to viśvo); yonder

वि.hi: (तिष्ठेका उपसर्ग) — वि तिष्ठे: फैल जाती हूँ
वि.en: (prefix of tiṣṭhe) — vi tiṣṭhe: I spread out

why.सिद्ध्यन्त्युच्चाटनादीनि: Monier-Williams uccāṭana: causing a person to quit his place or occupation by incantations; 'driving away' alone is vague
why.निमन्त्रयामास: Monier-Williams nimantrita: invited, summoned; 'bound' is the commentators' reading (नियन्त्रित), with कीलितम् in kilaka.8, as our meaning reads it; 'restricted' dropped
why.सम्पत्तिरुच्चकैः: Monier-Williams uccakais: loud; greatly, in a high degree: 'abundantly' is not a listed sense
why.चैवापाटवं: Monier-Williams and Apte apāṭava: unskilfulness; sickness, illness: beside fear and untimely death it is sickness
why.पार्श्वके: locative singular (Monier-Williams pārśvaka, pārśva: the side, the region of the ribs), not a plural
why.मनःशोकविनाशिनी: मनः is the object of रक्षेत् and शोकविनाशिनी the goddess (each quarter pairs a part with a goddess), as our meaning reads it
why.सुपथा: kavacha.43: a goddess in the nominative, parallel to क्षेमङ्करी (पन्थानं सुपथा रक्षेत्); the instrumental of supathin does not fit the list
why.दैवीकला: Monier-Williams kalā: a small part, any single part or portion of a whole; 'power, potency' is not a listed sense
why.न्यूनैरपि: Monier-Williams nyūna: less, deficient, inferior; the line sets their strength against the king's mighty sceptre
why.यानुच्चार्याविशेषतः: या + अनुच्चार्या + विशेषतः, as our meaning reads it (MW an-uccārya: not to be pronounced): the negation is in अनुच्चार्या; the Hindi's slip नकी mended
why.एतद्वः: एतत् + वः: the वः (to you) belongs here, not to कथितं
why.कथितं: 2.8 and 13.2: वः and ते are words of their own (एतद्वः, एतत्ते)
why.स्तूयसे: present passive, second person singular, of स्तु; not an imperative
why.जगत्पात्यत्ति: जगत् पाति अत्ति: पाति is the verb (पा, लट् प्रथम पुरुष एकवचन), not a noun 'protector'
why.समुत्पाट्य: Monier-Williams sam-utpāṭita: torn completely out or away; from पट्, not from उत्पद् 'to arise'
why.विच्छिन्नजङ्घास्त्वपरे: Monier-Williams jaṅghā: the shank, the leg; not the thigh (जाँघ)
why.विचिन्वति: the finite verb of 2.68 (vi-√ci), as our meaning reads it, not a participle
why.निभृतात्मजभृत्यदारा: Monier-Williams nibhṛta: attached, faithful (MārkP.); quiet, humble, modest; Apte: modest, humble; true, faithful; 'obedient' is in neither
why.नैर्ऋत्यै: Monier-Williams nairṛtī: N. of Durgā (Devīm.); Apte: an epithet of Durgā; 'destructive power' is in neither
why.चितिरूपेण: Monier-Williams citi: the thinking mind, citing Devīm. v, 36 (this verse); चैतन्य as our meaning has it
why.भक्तिविनम्रमूर्तिभिः: the half has no अस्माभिः; the instrumental is general (मूर्ति: bodily form)
why.तुभ्यमग्निशौचे: agni-śauca, a bahuvrīhi: whose cleansing (śauca, Monier-Williams: cleanness, purification) is by fire
why.चाधरेणान्यान्: Monier-Williams adhara m.: the lower lip, the lip; neither dictionary gives 'jaw'
why.तलप्रहारेण: Monier-Williams tala: the palm; थप्पड़ (a slap) does not fit a lion's blow
why.दैत्यानामधिपं: adhipa is a ruler or chief, not a general (सेनापति); the object of प्राह takes को
why.मौर्वाः: the text reads मौर्वाः, not मौर्याः
why.योद्धुमभ्याययौ: अभ्याययौ is लिट् प्रथम पुरुष एकवचन (the subject Raktabīja), not feminine plural
why.शिवदूत्यभिदूषिताः: Monier-Williams abhi-dūṣita: wounded, injured; the fall is पेतुः's
why.रथस्थस्तथात्युच्चैर्गृहीतपरमायुधैः: Monier-Williams uccais ind.: aloft, high: the arms (भुजैः) are raised high, not Śumbha 'towering'
why.केचिन्नष्टा: with the ablative महाहवात् नष्ट is 'fled from'
why.मुद्गरं: Monier-Williams mudgara: a hammer, mallet, any hammer-like weapon; 'mace' is गदा's
why.शाकैरावृष्टेः: the second gloss was doubled; आ with the ablative वृष्टेः: until the rain
why.प्रतीक्षिष्याम्यहं: Monier-Williams and Apte prati-īkṣ: look at, regard, expect, bear with; 'accept' is not listed
why.तस्यां: 5.88 and 6.24 are locatives absolute; 12.12 is 'in that' (the great worship)
why.निर्विण्णोऽतिममत्वेन: Monier-Williams nirviṇṇa: despondent, depressed, disgusted with (instr.); Apte the same: the instrumental is the cause
why.प्रसभकृतिवशात्: Monier-Williams prasabha: forcibly, violently, exceedingly; no sense of haste
why.सोममाहनसं: Monier-Williams and Apte āhanas (of Soma): to be beaten or pressed out; 'swelling' is in neither
why.वाम्या: वामि + आ: प्र वामि, I blow forth; the आ belongs to आरभमाणा (padapāṭha)
why.रभमाणा: Monier-Williams ā-√rabh: to lay or take hold of; to begin; its आ is joined to वाम्या
why.पृथिव्यै: पृथिव्यैतावती is पृथिव्या एतावती (padapāṭha), beside दिवा: beyond heaven, beyond this earth
why.तावती: the tail of एतावती (Monier-Williams etāvat: so great)
why.सं: सं is the prefix of बभूव, first person perfect: 'I have become'
why.तामूं: (उ)त + अमूम्: not a word of its own (विश्वा उत अमूम्, padapāṭha)
why.वि: वि is the prefix of तिष्ठे, not a word of its own
